name: relai
description: Eval-driven improvement for AI agents. Build evals first, then improve your agent against them: evals from your traces, code and risks for agent applications, and from sessions, pull requests and git history for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: RELAI turns traces into requirements, risks and evaluations, and measures improvements against agreed behavioral, cost or latency objectives. Seven skills: start, discover, trace-review (project-owned trace review apps with persistent feedback), eval, improve, loop, coding-evals (agent-neutral evals for the coding agents a team uses, from its sessions, pull requests and git history). Supports Harbor and native runners, optional held-out tests, and bounded direct fixes.
defaultPrompt: Use RELAI's start skill to see where this agent stands and what to do next.
Use RELAI's loop skill to improve this agent from its traces.
Use RELAI's coding-evals skill to turn a pull request or coding session into a reusable coding-agent evaluation.
